root_cause_investigation_hint: scripts/check_branch_freshness.sh — investigate why local base was stale before rebase. Common cause: rebased against stale origin/main snapshot without git fetch first. Fix: use scripts/safe_push.sh which fetches + auto-rebases + pushes atomically.
closure_evidence: Root cause was real staleness on aria/pr-sweep-integration, six commits behind main, and it is now gone: origin/main...HEAD reads 0 behind, and the branch's final push went through with NO flags at all - not the freshness one, not the substrate one, not the skip-tests one. Fixed by merging origin/main in rather than rebasing, so the branch's 115 commits of history survived; five conflicts were resolved by hand, two of them by folding both sides together rather than picking a winner. The hint prescribed safe_push, which rebases - that was the wrong operation for this branch and rebasing it would have discarded the history the merge kept.
